asa_marshman: Nobody saw Henrik "Saint" Marshman arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in T-F18, and a quiet signaller under it.

Henrik "Saint" Marshman and Jakub "Smokes" Dependentkin spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Henrik "Saint" Marshman during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Henrik "Saint" Marshman heard a faint second conversation on the telephone line. Headquarters said only one line was connected.
The extra voice came back during Henrik "Saint" Marshman's test. It was talking about potatoes, which made enemy spies an unlikely explanation.
Henrik "Saint" Marshman traced the fault to two badly insulated wires touching near a junction. One of them belonged to the supply office.
With the wires separated, Henrik "Saint" Marshman's telephone carried only orders again. The section misses hearing what was for supper before it was served.

The Concord raiders came over at T-F18 in the middle of the night. Henrik "Saint" Marshman met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Henrik "Hollow" Elm of the Concord (@elm227987).
Another member of the House of Marshman reached the line: Emil Marshman. He asked where Henrik "Saint" Marshman had slept, then chose a different corner.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Emil Marshman aimed a step ahead and fired: Teodor Beaucookie, grazed.
briant._.wilson: On Day 11, Benedikt "Saint" Wilson arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Benedikt "Saint" Wilson watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Benedikt "Saint" Wilson saved the last of the sugar for Nils King's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Nils's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
Nils King pulled Benedikt "Saint" Wilson out of a flooded shell hole at Verdel Ridge. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Benedikt "Saint" Wilson found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.

A bullet hit Benedikt "Saint" Wilson in the neck at P-F18. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Tobias Olly of the Concord (@olly.a2019). Benedikt "Saint" Wilson was killed outright at P-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Tobias Olly of the Concord (@olly.a2019).
The House of Wilson sent another. Karel "Doc" Wilson, brother of Benedikt "Saint" Wilson, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Karel "Doc" Wilson of the Hegemony lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at Calvary Farm. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Dorian Wellington's name scratched on the lid.
Karel "Doc" Wilson checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.
byzantineempireirl: Walter Byzantineemp walked into S-S9 on Day 5 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Walter Byzantineemp borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. Hill 304 is in Hegemony hands. Walter Byzantineemp stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
The parcel for Walter Byzantineemp contained six left socks. By supper, he had found three men willing to trade.
The telephone went dead during the shelling. Walter Byzantineemp watched the runner leave with the written orders, then listened for the phone to ring again.
Walter Byzantineemp has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Walter Byzantineemp was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Walter Byzantineemp helped stack spare sandbags at S-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

The dugout has begun inventing endings to Walter Byzantineemp's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing. Walter Byzantineemp got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 367. The men who came later will ask about it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Walter Byzantineemp wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
On dawn watch at S-S9, Walter Byzantineemp fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Jonas "Rabbit" Chivrex, now grazed.
Walter Byzantineemp and Otto Won tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
The missing instalment reached Walter Byzantineemp. The explanation was so poor that the dugout voted to keep the cook's ending.
Walter Byzantineemp cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.
Walter Byzantineemp and Gustav Kid split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Walter Byzantineemp hauled ammunition boxes up the communication trench all night. His back filed a formal complaint.
ckrueger247: Emil Ckrueger arrived at U-F3 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at U-F3 changed before the cheering ended. Emil Ckrueger shouldered another load.
An empty jam tin became Emil Ckrueger's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
During a lull at the Ossuary Wood, Emil Ckrueger called across from the Hegemony line. Dorian Noahz answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
Emil Ckrueger received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork.
Emil Ckrueger tried to describe the smell of Port Abel and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Emil Ckrueger was hit hard in the fight at U-F3 before anyone could fire. The raider was Karel Nguyen of the Concord. Raider: Karel Nguyen of the Concord (@khoi_nguyen6789).
Three days with a bandage, and Emil Ckrueger is back at U-F3. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
el_juanito67h: Dorian "Ash" Juanito came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

A bullet went through Dorian "Ash" Juanito's sleeve at S-R5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Zeno Emperornoble of the Hegemony (@emperornoblez). Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian "Ash" Juanito heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Dorian "Ash" Juanito rejoined the squad at S-R5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dorian "Ash" Juanito answered to number 930. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-R5 with the rations. Dorian "Ash" Juanito ate while listening to the revised orders.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Dorian "Ash" Juanito's ear at S-R5 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Henrik Dmt of the Hegemony (@rares.dmt_).
Three days with a bandage, and Dorian "Ash" Juanito is back at S-R5. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Dorian "Ash" Juanito (Concord) and Henrik "Parson" Ruthenianfas (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at Grey Mill at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
A bullet hit Dorian "Ash" Juanito's belt buckle at S-R5 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Edmund Seanlively of the Hegemony (@seanlively95).

A sniper's bullet hit Dorian "Ash" Juanito at S-R5. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Silas Karli of the Hegemony (@hunt_karli). Dorian "Ash" Juanito was killed on watch at S-R5. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Silas Karli of the Hegemony (@hunt_karli).
Cyril Juanito had heard about Dorian "Ash" Juanito's courage. At S-R5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Cyril Juanito was hit in the foot through his boot at S-R5. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Zeno Emperornoble of the Hegemony (@emperornoblez). The bearers reached Cyril Juanito at S-R5 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Zeno Emperornoble of the Hegemony (@emperornoblez).
The House of Juanito sent Roland Juanito after Cyril Juanito. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
falloutcat123: Leopold Falloutcat, a brewer from Brennmoor, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in S-R2. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Leopold Falloutcat wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The whole squad at S-R2 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Leopold Falloutcat's bullet that found Konrad "Owl" Kino, grazed. The clerk counted the names twice. Leopold Falloutcat is number 985 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Leopold Falloutcat stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Leopold Falloutcat accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.
Leopold Falloutcat was promoted to Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain.
Two shots, one miss. The second found Ulrich Tym, grazed. Leopold Falloutcat cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not.
Leopold Falloutcat fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Albin "Tin" Ringwraith, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Leopold Falloutcat fired, and Cyril "Ghost" Kkrogheemil was gravely wounded.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Leopold Falloutcat ate two helpings anyway.
gardinerryker: Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke told the sergeant he was a printer's apprentice. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Dawn watch. Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bastian "Bones" Jit, badly wounded.
Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.

Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke was hit twice at P-F8, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Wendel Aokiji of the Concord (@aokiji89_). The bearers reached Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke at P-F8 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Wendel Aokiji of the Concord (@aokiji89_).
Leopold Gardinerryke joined P-F8 under the shadow of Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Leopold Gardinerryke across the shin at P-F8. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Walter "Spark" Cthulhu of the Concord (@cthulhu1703).
Leopold Gardinerryke tried to stay at his post with the wound. By evening he could not stand, and the bearers took him back.
good_ol_rags: Leopold Rags arrived with the Day 10 draft, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Leopold Rags fed a new belt into the gun and laid it on the enemy path at Q-F7. Before dawn Ulrich Dutch walked into it, grazed. A letter from home found Leopold Rags before the night shift. Leopold Rags folded it small and kept it close. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Leopold Rags folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Leopold Rags fired at a movement across the wire at Q-F7. The man went down: Ulrich Dutch, badly wounded. Leopold Rags had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic crossed it, Leopold Rags fired. Anselm "Brick" Keggaholic was grazed. A letter from home found Leopold Rags before the night shift. Leopold Rags folded it small and kept it close.
Across from Q-F7, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Leopold Rags saw it. Benedikt "Owl" Dutch was grazed.
Leopold Rags and Arno "Brick" Android cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.

Leopold Rags fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Albin Life was grazed trying to cross it. A letter from home found Leopold Rags before the night shift. Leopold Rags folded it small and kept it close.
Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Leopold Rags spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Leopold Rags across the shin at Q-F7. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Roland Eugeneous of the Concord (@eugeneous911).
grishagoblin: "You're late," said the corporal when Florian Grishagoblin arrived on Day 15. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Florian Grishagoblin counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Hugo Gdaydane never saw the shovel coming. (@gdaydane) The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Florian Grishagoblin fought Teodor Victoria in a trench no wider than a door. Florian Grishagoblin came home with Teodor Victoria's cap badge. (@1980_crown_victoria) Back from the raid, Florian Grishagoblin found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Hello' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. A letter for Florian Grishagoblin came all the way from home in nine days. Florian Grishagoblin counted them on the envelope.

Somebody across the wire was singing. Then Cyril Monsterjohn stood up to sing louder, and Florian Grishagoblin fired. Cyril Monsterjohn was badly wounded. The singing stopped. There was a letter for Florian Grishagoblin and a little tobacco folded inside. The tobacco went round the squad. The letter did not.
horton_mg: At the depot, Bastian "Spark" Horton had practised answering to his name. At V-F16, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate. The chaplains took Bastian "Spark" Horton in on a busy morning in V-F16. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Silas "Tin" Roman owes Bastian "Spark" Horton so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Spark" Horton. Bastian "Spark" Horton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Bastian "Spark" Horton added a leak above the man's head in pencil.

Bastian "Spark" Horton tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bastian "Spark" Horton. Bastian "Spark" Horton read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Bastian "Spark" Horton spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.

Bastian "Spark" Horton wrote letters for men who could not write, and some for men who could but did not know the words. A letter came for Bastian "Spark" Horton with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Bastian "Spark" Horton pinned it to the dugout wall.
Bastian "Spark" Horton wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
hunterlloydhart: Tobias Hunterlloydh arrived on Day 16 as a replacement. The men in W-F16 had been fighting for 16 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Tobias Hunterlloydh approved the method.
jasmandeep_singh999: Felix "Tin" Singh signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F5 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F5 and grazed Felix "Tin" Singh's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Felix Szymanski of the Hegemony (@franek.szymanski.376).
Felix "Tin" Singh no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Felix "Tin" Singh's helmet at S-F5 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Felix "Tin" Singh kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Felix "Tin" Singh is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Felix "Tin" Singh received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Tin" Singh fired once through the steel loophole at S-F5 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Dietrich "Button" Slade was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Tin" Singh had Karel Mccauley of the Hegemony in the sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Karel Mccauley was lighting a pipe. Felix "Tin" Singh let the match burn all the way down. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.

Felix "Tin" Singh made it into the enemy trench and out again, but a machine gun swept no man's land on the way home. Felix "Tin" Singh crawled the last yards. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Felix "Tin" Singh read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

No bed for Felix "Tin" Singh yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. A letter from home reached Felix "Tin" Singh before dusk. Felix "Tin" Singh read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Felix "Tin" Singh is number 209 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Felix "Tin" Singh wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Felix "Tin" Singh. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Pavel Singh put a lock of hair in a matchbox beside the bunk. Someone who had known Felix "Tin" Singh helped clear the shelf without saying why.
A bullet grazed Pavel Singh's ribs at S-F5. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Oskar Londonz of the Hegemony (@londonz_29).
Pavel Singh's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F5 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.

Pavel Singh raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F5. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Cyril Rttr of the Hegemony (@19rttr97). A letter from home reached Pavel Singh before dusk. Pavel Singh read it twice and slept a little easier.
A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel Singh in the thigh at S-F5. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony (@tonyhuang000).

Pavel Singh spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. Pavel Singh got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.
k_a_r_l____: Hugo Karl arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a child's drawing of a horse and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Konrad "Spark" Pathfinder of the Concord and Hugo Karl of the Hegemony share the same habit: a whistle at midnight. Both lines at Hill 304 now wait for it before they sleep. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Hugo Karl watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at T-F7 and grazed Hugo Karl's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Oskar "Rabbit" Type of the Concord (@mg42svt40m1919type99k98k).
Hugo Karl's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at T-F7 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Leopold "Whistle" Leh (Concord) and Hugo Karl (Hegemony) watched each other through the same loophole at the Bone Quarry for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
Rain blew in under the dugout door. Hugo Karl moved his boots out of the wet, then realized they were already inside.
A man asked Hugo Karl to sit nearby without saying anything. He stayed until the man fell asleep.
Hugo Karl found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
kamdensipple: Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple walked into S-F6 on Day 3 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could. Orders came through: Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.
A clear shot from S-F6. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple grazed Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob and slid back down below the parapet.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.

Dawn watch. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bram "Crow" Mitaylor, badly wounded. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F6. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple has learned to walk bent double.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Silas Zdsh (Hegemony) and Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at the Drowned Farm. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.

Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F6. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2). Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Ulrich Pgallo was grazed.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple walked back up the communication trench to S-F6, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Albin Mouthfullofr, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Face blackened with soot, Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Ulrich "Smokes" Badbadmannnn was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple is number 196. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple used it. Ivo Pgallo was grazed.
Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Otto Dunkmyanactu, was gravely wounded.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.

A bullet struck Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple below the ribs at S-F6. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2). Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple was killed at S-F6 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Casimir Schradog of the Hegemony (@schradog2).
Jakub Kamdensipple put a rosary of rough beads beside the bunk. Someone who had known Otto "Saint" Kamdensipple helped clear the shelf without saying why.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F6 they left Jakub Kamdensipple behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Bastian "Shadow" Grantcsst of the Hegemony (@grantcsst).
A letter came with Rafael "Parson" Kamdensipple: "I am Jakub Kamdensipple's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
A bullet grazed Rafael "Parson" Kamdensipple's ribs at S-F6. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Gustav Chongo of the Hegemony (@big__chongo).
kolonics.akos.jozsef: After 6 days of war, R-S12 had a place for everything. On Day 6, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Clement "Saint" Jozsef.
Clement "Saint" Jozsef dreamt he was back in Lindenbruck, working as a coal miner. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Clement "Saint" Jozsef passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
During a lull at Calvary Farm, Isidor Glc called across from the Concord line. Clement "Saint" Jozsef answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at R-S12 changed before the cheering ended. Clement "Saint" Jozsef shouldered another load.

Clement "Saint" Jozsef was found at the bottom of the trench at R-S12, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Teodor "Spark" Levitobambit of the Concord (@levitobambito). Clement "Saint" Jozsef reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Clement "Saint" Jozsef opened his eyes today and asked for water. At R-S12 they cheered when the news came up the line. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Clement "Saint" Jozsef is number 452. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Clement "Saint" Jozsef could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
The man in the next bed snored all day. Clement "Saint" Jozsef did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing.
Clement "Saint" Jozsef returned to R-S12 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
Clement "Saint" Jozsef and Pavel Reider spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1.

A bullet found Clement "Saint" Jozsef at R-S12, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Pavel Mcm of the Concord (@joe_mcm09). Clement "Saint" Jozsef stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-S12. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Pavel Mcm of the Concord (@joe_mcm09).
Bram Jozsef asked about Clement "Saint" Jozsef on arriving at R-S12. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

Bram Jozsef saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-S12 and fired once. Jakub Rosing was grazed. Bram Jozsef fired at a movement across the wire at R-S12. The man went down: Quentin Cade, badly wounded.
Bram Jozsef fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-S12. Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
leopoldda1nonly: Severin Nonly stepped off the supply cart at R-C7 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Severin Nonly fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Anselm "Owl" Donnyredd, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Severin Nonly watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Severin Nonly spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. Severin Nonly got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 671. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Severin Nonly did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Severin Nonly tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper.
Emil Yijoon and Severin Nonly split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

A bullet hit Severin Nonly in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-C7. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Felix Topekeno of the Concord (@topekeno). Severin Nonly stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-C7. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Felix Topekeno of the Concord (@topekeno).
Florian "Parson" Nonly arrived carrying the family name of Severin Nonly. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Florian "Parson" Nonly spent the day watching one loophole in the enemy line. At dusk a periscope rose in it. He let it go. Tomorrow.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Florian "Parson" Nonly gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Florian "Parson" Nonly. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
manningwam: Day 7: Benedikt Manningwam reached S-S5 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Benedikt Manningwam moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long.
Benedikt Manningwam drew a map of Norbert Bwk's hometown from Norbert's stories. Norbert says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Benedikt Manningwam fought Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski in a trench no wider than a door. Benedikt Manningwam came home with Konrad "Whistle" Szymanski's cap badge. (@franek.szymanski.376) After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Benedikt Manningwam helped stack spare sandbags at S-S5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A bullet hit Benedikt Manningwam in the neck at S-S5. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Silas Karli of the Hegemony (@hunt_karli). Benedikt Manningwam stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-S5. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Silas Karli of the Hegemony (@hunt_karli).

The papers connected Matthias Manningwam to Benedikt Manningwam. The men took longer to learn Matthias Manningwam's own habits, but they made the effort. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Matthias Manningwam answered to number 478. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Matthias Manningwam wrote to a wife and a daughter he has never met that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A single shot from across the wire hit Matthias Manningwam in the thigh at S-S5. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Zeno Tonyhuang of the Hegemony (@tonyhuang000).
Matthias Manningwam died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Bram "Mud" Manningwam had heard about Matthias Manningwam's courage. At S-S5, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Bram "Mud" Manningwam asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Bram "Mud" Manningwam had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Casimir Schradog was gravely wounded.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Bram "Mud" Manningwam changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.

A bullet found Bram "Mud" Manningwam at S-S5, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Edmund Seanlively of the Hegemony (@seanlively95). A single shot at S-S5. Bram "Mud" Manningwam sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Edmund Seanlively of the Hegemony (@seanlively95).
Zeno Manningwam came to the front because his older brother Bram "Mud" Manningwam never came home. He carries his mother's thimble.
nza_amin: Isidor Amin told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Isidor Amin watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Isidor Amin passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Isidor Amin wrote to a wife and a daughter he has never met that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A borrowed pencil wore down while Isidor Amin was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Isidor Amin gave Lucien Kattawar the last match in the trench. Lucien used it to light a candle so that Isidor could finish a letter.
A splinter opened Isidor Amin's cheek at T-S7. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold.
Isidor Amin came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
A report called the trench satisfactory. Isidor Amin invited the author to spend a night in it before signing.
The corporal found out Isidor Amin used to be a tailor. Isidor Amin has been doing two jobs ever since.
ofieczkaares: Silas Ofieczkaares walked into R-C15 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Silas Ofieczkaares stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Frost on the wire made it sing in the wind. Silas Ofieczkaares could not stop listening to it. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Silas Ofieczkaares answered to number 686. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In R-C15, Silas Ofieczkaares listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Silas Ofieczkaares dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Silas Ofieczkaares fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Silas Ofieczkaares changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Dawn watch. Silas Ofieczkaares put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dorian "Parson" Kennypulkine, gravely wounded.
Silas Ofieczkaares was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-C15. Silas Ofieczkaares fired at the last man to run. Clement Brunoescobar was gravely wounded.
salty__trout: Lucien Trout came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.

Lucien Trout was carrying water up to R-R12 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Lucien Trout did not. Shot by Ulrich "Parson" Monster of the Concord (@krotral222monster). Lucien Trout was killed on watch at R-R12. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Ulrich "Parson" Monster of the Concord (@krotral222monster).
Arno "Hollow" Trout joined R-R12 under the shadow of Lucien Trout's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Arno "Hollow" Trout thought about a grandmother who prays for both armies on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Arno "Hollow" Trout helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Arno "Hollow" Trout fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Wendel Schwols (Concord) and Arno "Hollow" Trout (Hegemony) spotted the same abandoned cart near Blackwater Canal. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was.
Arno "Hollow" Trout found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.

Arno "Hollow" Trout was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R12. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ivo "Bones" David of the Concord (@david2449_).
Arno "Hollow" Trout rejoined the squad at R-R12. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Arno "Hollow" Trout borrowed the sergeant's periscope, found a target, handed it back, and fired. Yann Mixtapethepy was badly wounded. Arno "Hollow" Trout smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Jakub Rosing came out for a cup and was badly wounded.
seamus_bj: The new sniper gave his name as Norbert Seamus. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week.
A bullet went through Norbert Seamus's sleeve at S-F19 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Emil Ghostbebrii of the Hegemony (@ghostbebrii).

Norbert Seamus no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

A newspaper reached Norbert Seamus with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier. The sergeant read out the order: Hill 304 has fallen, hold the line. Norbert Seamus looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Norbert Seamus fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Seamus fired at a movement across the wire at S-F19. The man went down: Albin Donaldgregor, grazed. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.
Norbert Seamus took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Dietrich Thky, badly wounded.

Norbert Seamus watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-F19 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Emil Ghostbebrii was grazed. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Norbert Seamus wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier.

Norbert Seamus lost a boot in the trench. Casimir "Mole" Vitocarciopp found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word. A letter from home reached Norbert Seamus before dusk. Norbert Seamus read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Norbert Seamus is number 224. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Norbert Seamus watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Norbert Seamus waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Cyril Bananaman did, and was gravely wounded.
Norbert Seamus found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
Norbert Seamus's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Norbert Seamus found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful.

Norbert Seamus fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-F19. Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. Norbert Seamus found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Norbert Seamus read it while the kettle boiled.

Norbert Seamus saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-F19 and fired once. Rafael "Mole" Jedrk was badly wounded. Norbert Seamus was found at the bottom of the trench at S-F19, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Wendel Clan of the Hegemony (@frogman.clan). Norbert Seamus was killed at S-F19 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Wendel Clan of the Hegemony (@frogman.clan).
Pavel Seamus took the same post at S-F19 where Norbert Seamus stood. He found his father's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
uselesmagikarp: The draft reached T-F17 on Day 10. Bram Uselesmagika was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Bram Uselesmagika reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F17 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut of the Concord (@juggernaut_dd). Victory at Grey Mill. Bram Uselesmagika let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Bram Uselesmagika returned to T-F17 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Bram Uselesmagika thought about a mother who sets a place for him at every meal on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
A round went through Bram Uselesmagika's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Henrik "Owl" Juggernaut of the Concord (@juggernaut_dd).

A bullet struck Bram Uselesmagika below the ribs at T-F17. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch of the Concord (@paintbusch). The bearers reached Bram Uselesmagika at T-F17 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch of the Concord (@paintbusch).
The House of Uselesmagika sent another. Teodor "Brick" Uselesmagika, uncle of Bram Uselesmagika, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.

Teodor "Brick" Uselesmagika was hit through the chest at T-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike of the Concord (@dababyislike). Teodor "Brick" Uselesmagika was hit at T-F17 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike of the Concord (@dababyislike).
A letter came with Konrad Uselesmagika: "I am Teodor "Brick" Uselesmagika's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Konrad Uselesmagika took the long way round the Drowned Farm because the short way had a sniper on it. The long way had two.
vis.acquillae: Edmund Acquillae left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Halden and came up the line with a stub of a pencil. The men noticed at once that he polishes his buttons every evening.
Volunteer number 34. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Edmund Acquillae's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Edmund Acquillae asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a signaller. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
Edmund Acquillae was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.

Edmund Acquillae taught Silas Zdsh to play the harmonica. The bay has asked them both, formally, to stop. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Edmund Acquillae wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Edmund Acquillae dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

A direct hit on the trench at S-F10. Edmund Acquillae was the only one they could still help, and only just. Edmund Acquillae was killed outright by a direct hit at S-F10. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.

Isidor Acquillae joined S-F10 under the shadow of Edmund Acquillae's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Isidor Acquillae received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on. Now serving as a signaller, Isidor Acquillae discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Isidor Acquillae spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F10 is closed now. Isidor Acquillae raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F10. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Wendel "Mole" Day of the Concord (@selfie_and_mugs_every_day2.0). Mail came up the line with a letter for Isidor Acquillae. Isidor Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Isidor Acquillae helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F10. Isidor Acquillae took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Oskar Pearson of the Concord (@_william.pearson_). Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Isidor Acquillae died waiting. The men at S-F10 have not stopped talking about it.

The papers connected Roland Acquillae to Isidor Acquillae. The men took longer to learn Roland Acquillae's own habits, but they made the effort. Roland Acquillae was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns. Roland Acquillae's transfer to the role of stretcher bearer was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else. Roland Acquillae bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.'

Roland Acquillae made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Acquillae began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A round went through Roland Acquillae's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Cyril "Rabbit" Coreyjmcmich of the Concord (@coreyjmcmichael). Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medic cut the last bandage off Roland Acquillae's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-F10 the same hour. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Roland Acquillae let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Roland Acquillae was made Lance Corporal. He celebrated by sleeping four hours in a row. Mail came up the line with a letter for Roland Acquillae. Roland Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Roland Acquillae watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

A bullet hit Roland Acquillae in the neck at S-F10. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Roland Potato of the Concord (@combat_potato1). Roland Acquillae was hit at S-F10 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Roland Potato of the Concord (@combat_potato1).
The papers say Pavel Acquillae. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Roland Acquillae's eyes. Nobody in S-F10 argues.

A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel Acquillae in the thigh at S-F10. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Ivo Gabhita of the Concord (@gabhita09). Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Acquillae. Pavel Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Pavel Acquillae spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Acquillae. Pavel Acquillae read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Nobody could reach Pavel Acquillae in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Casimir Acquillae arrived carrying the family name of Pavel Acquillae. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Casimir Acquillae counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Henrik "Bones" Lafayette never saw the shovel coming. (@marquis_de_lafayette1757_1834) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Casimir Acquillae landed next to Otto Commanderchr in the Concord trench. Only Casimir Acquillae climbed back out. (@commanderchris__) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Casimir Acquillae snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Casimir Acquillae free. A letter from home reached Casimir Acquillae before dusk. Casimir Acquillae read it twice and slept a little easier. A German shepherd came up the line with the ration party and would not leave Casimir Acquillae's side. Casimir Acquillae named the dog Toby. The sergeant pretended not to see.
Casimir Acquillae did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.

Another member of the House of Acquillae reached the line: Ulrich Acquillae. He asked where Casimir Acquillae had slept, then chose a different corner. Toby did not eat for two days after Casimir Acquillae fell. On the third day it walked up to Ulrich Acquillae and sat down. That was that.
vonmaverick: Severin Vonmaverick came up with a draft of replacements on Day 11. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it. Grey Mill has been won. Severin Vonmaverick listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
A man asked Severin Vonmaverick to describe Port Abel without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Severin Vonmaverick's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A round went through the rim of Severin Vonmaverick's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Cyril Indinsea of the Concord (@indinsea01z).
The medic looked at Severin Vonmaverick's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to U-F18. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

Severin Vonmaverick was on watch at U-F18 when the night raid hit. The men found Severin Vonmaverick at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Clement Realjospence of the Concord (@realjospence).
The papers say Hugo Vonmaverick. The sergeant says he has his older brother's eyes. Severin Vonmaverick's eyes. Nobody in U-F18 argues.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Hugo Vonmaverick waited for that to change. When it did, Otto "Spark" Kraljmk was gravely wounded.
